programs.name: Computer Science
programs.notes: Entry is through the Faculty of Science, which requires mathematics plus two of biology, chemistry, and physics. Québec applicants are assessed on their CEGEP R-score; out-of-province applicants are assessed on their grade-12 average. Listed prerequisites are Ontario 4U equivalents; other provinces' equivalents are accepted.

tips.title: Application deadline
tips.detail: Apply directly to McGill by February 1, 2027 for Fall 2027 entry; verify the current cycle's deadline on McGill's admissions site.

tips.title: Basic Entrance Scholarship consideration
tips.detail: All admitted students are automatically considered for McGill's one-time Basic Entrance Scholarship. Recent recipients have typically presented averages of roughly 93% and above; exact cutoffs vary by year and faculty.
